Join the tailnet (do this once, then come back):
  sudo tailscale up --ssh=false
Open the URL it prints, sign in, and approve the machine "test-box".
Check:  tailscale status      (shows this machine and the VPS "prod-server")

LAPTOP LID TEST (after the reboot; details: docs/source/laptop-server-setup.md §5.1)
  1. Start the logger:
       nohup bash -c 'while true; do echo "$(date +%T) up=$(cut -d" " -f1 /proc/uptime) lid=$(awk "{print \$2}" /proc/acpi/button/lid/*/state)"; sleep 10; done' >> ~/lid-test.log 2>&1 &
  2. Close the lid for 5 to 10 minutes, open it, then read:  cat ~/lid-test.log
  3. Pass: lid=closed rows about 10 seconds apart, no gaps, and "uptime -s" has not changed.
  Wi-Fi can still stall; an Ethernet cable is strongly recommended.

VPS CHECKLIST for ai-n4 (run on the VPS as root; details: docs/source/vps-ai-nodes-setup.md §6)
  1. On this node, check llama answers:   curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
  2. DNS: Route 53 zone marin.cr (ZTESTZONE0001): A record ai-n4.marin.cr -> 192.0.2.10, TTL 300
  3. From the VPS:  tailscale ping test-box
       Pattern B:  curl -i --resolve test-box.tailtest.ts.net:443:198.51.100.4 https://test-box.tailtest.ts.net/health
  4. Bootstrap HTTP vhost /opt/infra/proxy/nginx/conf.d/ai-n4.marin.cr.conf (ACME webroot + redirect);
       docker exec proxy-nginx nginx -t && docker exec proxy-nginx nginx -s reload
  5. Certificate: certbot webroot for ai-n4.marin.cr (email admin@example.test)
  6. Final HTTPS vhost: copy ai-n2.marin.cr.conf (Pattern B); change names, cert paths,
       proxy_pass IP and proxy_ssl_name/Host. Keep Authorization passthrough, buffering off, timeouts 15s/600s/600s.
  7. Validate: unauthenticated /v1/models -> 401; with the key -> 200.
  8. Commit the vhost in marin-server-infra; optionally add the node to Open WebUI.
